task.text:
[0] Integration of hif-1 extra copies to genome extended the lifespan of daf-16 (ortholog of FOXO genes) knockout worms.

[1] Overexpressed dFOXO, a downstream effector of IIS, in the adult Drosophila fat body, which increased life-span and reduced fecundity of females but had no effect on male life-span. The role of FOXO transcription factors and the adipose tissue are therefore evolutionarily conserved in the regulation of aging, and reduction of insulin/insulin-like growth factor signaling in the adult is sufficient to mediate its effects on life-span and fecundity. Induced expression of dFOXO in the fat body from the onset of adulthood increased life-span and reduced fecundity of female flies by 20 to 50% and by 50%, respectively.

[2] Total N=545, foxo was with the three protein kinase B (PKB) phosphorylation sites mutated to permit insulin- insensitive nuclear transport (UAS–dFOXO-TM).

[3] Total N=258, foxo was with the three protein kinase B (PKB) phosphorylation sites mutated (mutations T44A, S190A and S259A) to permit insulin- insensitive nuclear transport (UAS–dFOXO-TM).

[4] foxo was with the three protein kinase B (PKB) phosphorylation sites mutated (mutations T44A, S190A and S259A) to permit insulin- insensitive nuclear transport (UAS–dFOXO-TM). Total N=548

[5] foxo was with the three protein kinase B (PKB) phosphorylation sites mutated (mutations T44A, S190A and S259A) to permit insulin- insensitive nuclear transport (UAS–dFOXO-TM). Total N=505

[6] foxo was with the three protein kinase B (PKB) phosphorylation sites mutated (mutations T44A, S190A and S259A) to permit insulin- insensitive nuclear transport (UAS–dFOXO-TM). Total N=539

[7] Total N=263, foxo was with the three protein kinase B (PKB) phosphorylation sites mutated (mutations T44A, S190A and S259A) to permit insulin- insensitive nuclear transport (UAS–dFOXO-TM).

[8] foxo was with the three protein kinase B (PKB) phosphorylation sites mutated (mutations T44A, S190A and S259A) to permit insulin- insensitive nuclear transport (UAS–dFOXO-TM). Total N=561

[9] foxo was with the three protein kinase B (PKB) phosphorylation sites mutated (mutations T44A, S190A and S259A) to permit insulin- insensitive nuclear transport (UAS–dFOXO-TM). Total N=593

Each numbered passage describes one lifespan experiment. For each, report three things using ONLY that passage:
  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.
